name: Water for injection / purified water
notes: Water grade per step from EMA guidance Table 3 (SRC-EMA-WATER-2018): for a non-sterile active substance intended for a parenteral product, PURIFIED WATER at any step excluding final isolation. For an isolated (not-in-solution) spray-dried powder, purified water is acceptable at final isolation too - WFI is NOT automatically required, a real capital saving - BUT the guideline's footnote shifts the burden: an endotoxin and microbiological specification must then be set on the drug substance (Q-037). Largest consumer is diafiltration (diavolume-driven). Risk-based, not a rule.

name: Jacket heating (hot water / low-pressure steam)
driven_by: U01-LIG jacket: blockmer anneal ramp to 65 C and return
notes: REGISTERED 2026-09-25 to close a duty that had no utility behind it. Listing all five existing utilities confirmed that NONE heats a reactor jacket: UT-STEAM is evaporator duty plus SIP and UT-CHILL is condensers, jacket cooling and cold holds. Yet the demonstrated route anneals blockmers at 65 C for 15 min before every ligation and a double-stranded-RNA ligase cannot work without that duplex (P-LIG-ANNEAL-T, P-LIG-ANNEAL-HOLD, SRC-ALMAC-2023, Q-001). THIS IS A HEATING GAP FOR THE ANNEAL AND NOTHING ELSE. It is deliberately NOT sized for an enzyme denature hold: whether that step exists is undecided (Q-059), which enzyme form it would serve is undecided (Q-050), and putting its duty here would half-commit to a branch nobody has chosen. The anneal duty stands on its own regardless of how either question resolves. MAGNITUDE, ours and first-principles: the ramp to 65 C and back is a sensible-heat duty of order 170 kJ per kg of solution, roughly three orders of magnitude above the reaction enthalpy even taking a pyrophosphate-hydrolysis analogue as an upper bound, so the ramp is the whole of the duty and no calorimetry is needed to size it. Two open items travel with it. The grade is unsized because the required jacket temperature is unsized, and the ceiling on the way DOWN is set by enzyme stability rather than by the duplex, a figure not registered because its document could not be retrieved (Q-059). And the duty may not stay in this vessel: specific heat-transfer area falls as the cube root of volume, so 1 L to 1000 L loses 10x in area per unit volume and a 15 min ramp becomes of order 150 min at the same jacket temperature difference, or the anneal moves to a higher-area device (Q-065).
